My academic activities include undergraduate course assistance, guest lecturing in bioinformatics, research seminars, and scientific outreach for pre-university students.

---

## Guest Lectures & Workshops

* **Building Academic Websites with R & Postcards** | *February 2026*  
  *Guest Lecturer — LCG Bioinformatics Module (UNAM)*  
  Taught undergraduate students how to construct, design, and deploy clean academic personal websites using R Markdown and the `postcards` package.

* **Single-Nucleus RNA Sequencing (snRNA-seq) Workflows in Neurogenomics** | *February 2026*  
  *Guest Lecturer — LCG Bioinformatics Module (UNAM)*  
  Presented research from my project at the Lieber Institute for Brain Development (LIBD), detailing single-nucleus transcriptomic processing, quality control, and cell-type profiling in human brain tissue.

## Teaching Assistantships

### Course Assistant in Python Programming
**Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM)** | *Licenciatura en Ciencias Genómicas*  
*Period: February 2026 – June 2026*

* **Topics Covered:** Fundamentals of Python, data structures, object-oriented programming, numerical computing (`NumPy`, `Pandas`), and introductory algorithmic problem-solving for biological data.
* **Responsibilities:** Led practical coding sessions, graded assignments, provided one-on-one debugging support, and developed hands-on computational notebooks for genomics students.

---

### Course Assistant in Probability
**Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM)** | *Licenciatura en Ciencias Genómicas*  
*Period: August 2025 – December 2025*

* **Topics Covered:** Axiomatic probability, random variables, discrete and continuous probability distributions, joint distributions, limit theorems, and applications in biological modeling.
* **Responsibilities:** Facilitated problem-solving workshops, prepared review problem sets, graded exams, and explained mathematical concepts applied to genomics and computational biology.

## Science Outreach & Community Engagement

* **Exploring Erythrocyte Biology & Genomics** | *Month Year*  
  *Invited Speaker — Escuela Nacional Preparatoria No. 2 "Erasmo Castellanos Quinto" (UNAM)*  
  Presented research conducted at the Instituto de Biotecnología (IBt, UNAM) on erythrocyte biology to high school students, promoting interest in genomic sciences, biotechnology, and scientific careers.
